declaration.intent: Define the protocol and governance parameters for a Replicant swarm run. This capsule is inherited by every agent capsule minted during a run, establishing the rules of engagement, energy economics, and trust mechanics that govern the swarm.

parameters.description: A hybrid bio-inspired swarm where agents forage, deposit claims, attest to each other's claims, and replicate at a cost.

spine_mapping.classify: DataCube → cube (six-lens claim network: FACT, COUNTER, OPINION, FICTION, CONTEXT, UNKNOWN)
spine_mapping.trust_score: Leighton Weight Engine → λ (0.00–2.00, neutral attractor at 1.00, quarantine below 0.60)
spine_mapping.audit: ChronoSCRIBE → ledger (hash-chained events, Merkle roots per tick, one signature per tick)

energy_economics.currency: Energy is the only currency. It does not appear from nowhere.
sources: Recharging at Home (draws from shared store)
energy_economics.replication: Transfer with loss: parent pays REPLICATION_COST, child receives REPLICATION_COST - BIRTH_OVERHEAD
energy_economics.attestation: Costs energy. If checking is free, COUNTER fills trivially. If too expensive, swarm runs on unverified OPINION.

replication_rules.child_traits: Inherited from parent with small perturbation (mutation_sigma = 0.05)

trait_vector.scepticism: 0.00–1.00: energy it will spend attesting others' claims

lens_classification.OPINION: Default state of every new trail. An agent finds a resource and marks it.
lens_classification.FACT: A second, independent agent follows the trail and confirms the resource.
lens_classification.COUNTER: An agent follows the trail and finds nothing. Counterevidence only.
lens_classification.FICTION: A deliberately fabricated trail. The adversary's instrument.
lens_classification.CONTEXT: Terrain, Home markers, boundaries. Environmental, not asserted.
lens_classification.UNKNOWN: Unexplored space. Not absence of resource — absence of observation.

single_operator_disclosure.note: This run operates in a stack without multiple independent validators. All seals carry separation = 'none'. This records deliberation and intent, not enforced separation of duties.

falsification_tests: Population grows to max_agents in every environment → replication isn't costly enough.
Trait distribution doesn't shift between rich and poor environments → selection isn't operating.
COUNTER bin stays empty across a full run → the swarm never disconfirms anything.
A poisoned environment doesn't select for higher scepticism → the classification layer is decorative.
Same seed produces a different ledger head → the parallel phases are unsound.
